name: maut-claude-images
description: Sidebar gallery and terminal link integration for Claude Code image cache

commands.title: Choose How Claude Asks for Permission

maut.autoLaunchClsp.description: On opening a project folder, start Claude (continuing your last conversation there) if none is running in this window.

maut.autoEnterFocusMode.description: After auto-launching clsp on app open, also enter Maut Focus Mode (zen-style).

maut.autoResumeOnLaunch.description: After auto-launching clsp on app open, type `/resume` + Enter ~2s later to restore the last Claude conversation.

enumDescriptions: Never asks: Claude edits and runs commands freely.
Edits files without asking; asks before running commands.
Claude decides what is safe without asking.
Asks before each edit and each command.
Plans first and changes nothing until you approve.
Never asks: anything not already allowed is refused.
maut.claude.permissionMode.description: How Claude asks before acting, every time Maut starts Claude.

maut.claude.model.description: The model Maut starts Claude with: opus, sonnet, haiku or a full model name. Empty uses Claude Code's default.

maut.claude.extraArgs.description: More flags for claude when Maut starts it, like --add-dir ../shared.

maut.claude.command.description: The Claude Code executable Maut starts: claude, or a full path or wrapper script.
